## ErrorBoundary Design (FR-001, FR-002)

- [x] CHK001 Is the ErrorBoundary specified as a React class component, given that functional components cannot catch rendering errors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001] — Pass: research.md R1 confirms, plan.md and tasks.md T001 specify class component
- [x] CHK002 Are the exact MUI components for the fallback UI enumerated (Box, Typography, CircularProgress) with layout requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Clarification Q1] — Pass: FR-001 names Box, Typography, CircularProgress; Clarification Q1 resolved
- [x] CHK003 Is the auto-recovery timeout duration explicitly quantified (5 seconds) with rationale for that specific value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001] — Pass: FR-001 states 5 seconds; rationale in US1 priority explanation
- [x] CHK004 Are timer cleanup requirements on unmount explicitly specified to prevent memory leaks? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities — Error Boundary] — Pass: Key Entities state "Cleans up resources on unmount"; T001 includes componentWillUnmount cleanup
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements for multiple sequential errors defined — does the recovery timer reset correctly without stacking? [Coverage, Spec §US1-AS3] — Pass: US1-AS3 explicitly states "each recovery timer resets correctly without stacking"
- [x] CHK006 Is the error boundary's wrapping scope specified — does FR-002 clearly define it wraps the entire app at root level? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002] — Pass: FR-002 states "root application MUST be wrapped"; Assumptions confirm single root boundary
- [x] CHK007 Is the behavior when the fallback UI itself throws an error addressed in requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases] — Pass: Edge Cases section explicitly addresses this — "fallback must be minimal with no complex logic"

## Accessibility — aria-live (FR-005, FR-006, FR-007)

- [x] CHK014 Is the throttling interval for countdown announcements (once per minute) specified with rationale? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Clarification Q2] — Pass: FR-005 states "once per minute"; Clarification Q2 provides rationale (avoid flooding assistive technology)
- [x] CHK015 Is it clearly specified that the visual countdown continues every second while only the accessibility text is throttled? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005 vs FR-006] — Pass: FR-005 and FR-006 explicitly separate the two behaviors
- [x] CHK016 Is the specific aria-live value ("polite" vs "assertive") required for all live regions explicitly stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007] — Pass: FR-005 "live region" + FR-007 "polite live region"; Clarification Q6 confirms all use "polite"
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements for the announcements ticker's role and aria attributes specific enough (role="status", aria-live, role="marquee")? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007] — Pass: FR-007 specifies "status role and polite live region on its root container, with a marquee role on the scrolling text element"
